name: Innocent Grape
source:
All of us have a dream: to gain a lot of money, make up for the mistakes of our past, get a huge harem and even fondle boobs.... These dreams are so different but they are so important! They empower us to stand up and go forward, no matter what happens. Truly, a marvelous trait of who we are as a species!

And Ann's dream, you know... Anyway, we'll explain in plain language that her dream is kind of special and weird, cause she wants to be... roughly possessed. Who are we to criticize her? In the end, everybody's different!

Join Ann in her adventure of realizing her ultimate dream! There is nothing and no one that will be able to prevent her from pursuing her goal, whether it's furries, horny men, or even.... Oh, you know.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924050/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
我们每个人心中都怀揣着梦想：赚上大把钞票、弥补过去的遗憾、坐拥庞大后宫，甚至揉一揉美乳…这些梦想虽千差万别，却无一不至关重要！正是梦想赋予我们力量，让我们无论遭遇何种挫折都能重新站起来奋勇前行——这着实是我们人类这一物种最了不起的特质！

至于安的梦想嘛，怎么说呢…好吧，咱们就打开天窗说亮话吧：她的梦想颇有些特别又古怪，因为她渴望被人…粗暴地占有。我们又有什么资格对她指手画脚呢？毕竟人与人本就各不相同嘛！

快跟随安踏上实现终极梦想的冒险之旅吧！没有任何事物、也没有任何人能阻挡她追梦的脚步——无论是兽人、饥渴的男人，甚至是…哎呀，你懂的。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924050/]Steam[/url]]
